_doc: CT-01 one funny caption per minigame (keyed by meta.id) plus generic fallbacks. Shown by /client/fx/fail.js.

games.password-cracker: Password was 'password'. You still missed it.
games.packet-sniffer: You sniffed the wrong packet. It smelled like failure.
games.digital-lockpick: The tumblers tumbled. So did your career.
games.trace-the-ip: Traced. They know where you live. And what you had for lunch.
games.password-roulette: You spun the wheel. The wheel won.
games.security-camera-loop: Smile! You're the star of tonight's evidence reel.
games.data-heist: Your file got quarantined. So did you.
games.server-overload: The server is on fire. So is your reputation.
games.captcha-criminal: CAPTCHA says: definitely a robot. A bad one.
games.backdoor: The backdoor was a front door. With cops.
games.firewall-freeze: Froze at the wrong time. Classic.
games.digital-wiretap: You tapped the wire. The wire tapped back.
games.lockpick: Snapped the pick. And the lock. And your dignity.
games.laser-grid: Zapped! Now you glow in the dark.
games.guard-patrol: The guard says hi. And also you're under arrest.
games.safecracker: The safe cracked a joke at your expense.
games.getaway-driver: Getaway car? More like stay-here car.
games.security-badge: That badge belonged to the janitor.
games.disguise-check: Nobody believes you're the new guard, Kevin.
games.vault-weight: Too heavy! The vault floor snitched.
games.silent-alarm: The silent alarm was not so silent.
games.evidence-cleanup: You cleaned up someone else's crime. How generous.
games.the-inside-man: Your inside man was outside the whole time.
games.black-market-deal: The dealer kept the case. And your wallet.

generic: And that's why we wear gloves.
